captions.detailed: A modern, high-end bread maker featuring a light-grey metallic rectangular base and a black top cover assembly. The top section includes a broad main lid with a smaller integrated dispenser flap, alongside an angled control panel on the front. This control panel houses a circular rotary dial and three rectangular push buttons. Structurally, the main lid is designed to swing upward on a rear hinge, the dispenser flap rotates locally within the lid, and the control dial and buttons are fully articulated for rotation and linear depression.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a premium bread maker with a hollowed-out main base chamber, an articulated black main lid, an integrated dispenser flap, and a front control panel featuring a rotatable crust selector dial and three separate push buttons.
captions.factory: Construct a hollowed-out base box using CadQuery's boolean subtraction to create the loaf chamber. Build the main lid assembly as a separate part positioned on a rear rotational hinge axis. Model the dispenser flap, the front control panel face, the cylindrical rotary dial, and three small rectangular buttons as distinct articulated parts with appropriate revolute, continuous, and prismatic joints relative to their parent components.
